note: Both sets give the same five Figure 2-11 legend entries (pitch axis, mass/neutral/geometric/shear center), which are correct but essentially label-level claims. Set B adds two axial-stiffness claims that are wrong: it reads the axis tick labels as data, asserting 0 N at r/R = 0.0 and 1e10 N at r/R = 1.0, whereas plot (c) shows roughly 4.5e10 N at the root and near zero at the tip (1e10 is the axis multiplier). Set A therefore has no wrong claims while Set B has two misread/misbound ones, so A is better despite both omitting the mass-density and edge/flap/torsional stiffness data.
remarks: Both sets miss the substantive content of Figure 2-10: mass density vs span, and edge/flap/torsional stiffness vs span. The five 'structural property center' claims are just legend labels of Figure 2-11 with no values or span positions, so they carry little engineering content. Set B's axial-stiffness claims appear to be generated by pairing axis tick labels (0, 1e10) with x-axis endpoints rather than reading the curve.
